subject: Re: Private VPC / on-prem demo request for MedSecure
messages:
From: Alex Thornton <alex.thornton@medsecure.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T13:02:10Z
Subject: Private VPC / on-prem demo request for MedSecure

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — I signed up through the site and selected the Private/VPC demo option for MedSecure. We are a healthcare org and need to evaluate on-prem and VPC deployment options (data residency, network controls, and SOC2 evidence). Looking for a short demo this coming week to show to our engineering and security leads.

A few quick notes on what we care about:
- VPC peering vs. private deployment options
- KMS/HSM integrations and key management
- Audit logs and retention controls
- On-prem packaging and air-gapped install feasibility

Can you share availability? Also attaching a short one-pager with our requirements.

Thanks,
Alex Thornton
Head of Infra Security
MedSecure
Attachment: medsecure-reqs.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Hi Alex — great to meet you, and thanks for the details. Happy to set up a 30-minute demo to walk through Private / VPC options and then schedule a deeper technical session if needed.

Are any of these windows good for your team next week (we'll send an invite once you confirm):
- Wed, Aug 26 — 9:00 AM PDT / 17:00 UTC (30 min)
- Thu, Aug 27 — 9:00 AM PDT / 16:00 UTC (30 min)

Could you also confirm who from engineering/security will join so we can have our infra engineer on the call? I'll loop in Dev Patel (our platform engineer) for the technical Q&A.

Proposed brief agenda (I'll attach a one-pager):
1) 5-min intros
2) 15-min demo of Private/VPC features + deployment options
3) 10-min technical + next steps (connectivity, SOC2, timeline)

If you want a deeper on-prem technical review we'll schedule a follow-up with Dev.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Alex — thanks for the invite. I'm available for Wed 26th at 10:00 AM PDT and will join for the technical Q&A.

Quick notes to prep:
- For VPC deployments we support VPC peering and private link models; typical firewall rules are outbound TLS to specific IP ranges + a TCP port for metrics when using our managed control plane.
- For Private/on-prem we have an air-gapped installer and a lightweight control plane option; we'll review packaging options on the call.
- We'll bring a SOC2 snapshot to the meeting; attaching the 2025 summary here for your team.

See you on Wed — I'll send a shared calendar invite with dial-in and a short agenda.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
